licence_note: Third-party copyrighted rulebook PDFs. Not committed to the repo (gitignored). Filed in the personal library at G:\My Drive\Wargaming\Last Days\ and quoted here only for analysis/citation, per house research policy.
read_passes: Pass 1 (prior session): settlement/Refuge layer only — produced the original note

Pass 2 (this session): full read of both books for core resolution, turn structure, the Menace Phase / noise-and-ammo spawn loop, zombie AI, Knockback / Shoot Them in the Head, Breaking Point, the Injury Table, Seasons weather + Character Conditions (Hunger/Health/Thirst/Warmth), and Solo/Cooperative Play
notes: Core Refuge table (p.20) lists Farm House as 8 Max Group Size / 6 Empty Spaces / Fenced-Off Garden only. Seasons (p.64) explicitly replaces this entry with 8/5/Fenced-Off Garden-or-Stable+Cold Cellar — an errata-style overwrite, not an additive option. The vault note's Farm House row already reflected the Seasons-corrected numbers; this capture records the provenance so it's not mistaken for a core-book fact.

Vault note originally claimed 'only three Perks touch a normal away game: Armoury, Fortified Windows, Radio Room' as an INFERENCE. Full read shows Fortified Windows only ever modifies the off-table, abstracted Zombie Attack roll (p.83) and never appears in any on-table Encounter's text, including Home Defense. Corrected in the note — the accurate set is Armoury (fires inside any ordinary Encounter) and Radio Room (shifts which Encounter gets rolled), with Fortified Windows moved to the same off-table-economy bucket as Watch Tower's re-roll effect.
